{C:81930100}{C:81958296442300000000}Whoa?!
W-what's going on?

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296B60100000000}Oh, I'm sorry!

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296452300000000}I told you, didn't I?
It's dangerous to run.

{C:81958296462300000000}I'm sorry about that.
Come on, Churull, you apologize too!

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296B70100000000}I'm soooorry!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296472300000000}Oh, it's all right.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296482300000000}More importantly, are you hurt?
Um... Churull, was it?

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296B80100000000}Nope! I'm fine!

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296492300000000}I'm really sorry.
We'll be going now.


{C:81900300}{C:819582964A2300000000}They're such lively children.


{C:81900400}{C:819582964B2300000000}They're just like you, Rie.

{C:81900300}{C:819582964D2300000000}What's that supposed to mean?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582964E2300000000}(I thought so too,
but I'm glad I didn't say it...)





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190A802}{C:81958296272300000000}Hmm? Where might I be?
Oh, pretty laaadies!


{C:8190A802}{C:81958296292300000000}Pray, wait a moment!
You beautiful young ladies there,
would you answer a question for me?

{C:81900400}{C:819582962A2300000000}A hippo. A hippo's talking...

{C:81900300}{C:819582962B2300000000}Nelfea, that's rude.

{C:819582962C2300000000}Um, if it's something we know,
we'll answer.

{C:8190A802}{C:819582962D2300000000}I live on {C:819782830300}Mt. Soukai{C:819782830000}, and I am 
{C:819782830400}Shibaraku Tsurugibe{C:819782830000}, a master swordsman.

{C:81900300}{C:819582962E2300000000}Thank you for introducing yourself.
I'm Rie Akatsuki.
So, um, what was your question?

{C:8190A802}{C:819582962F2300000000}Where might I be?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296302300000000}Huh?

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296312300000000}I thought I was traveling with {C:819782830400}Wataru{C:819782830000} and {C:819782830400}Himiko{C:819782830000}
on Mt. Soukai, but...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296322300000000}I'm afraid we don't know
anything about this continent either.

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296342300000000}Hmm... Is this {C:819782830400}Doakudar{C:819782830000}'s trap?
Or perhaps...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296352300000000}Doakudar?

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296362300000000}Ah, forgive me.
I shall take my leave.


{C:81930100}{C:81958296372300000000}He seemed out of place
in all sorts of ways.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296382300000000}Yeah...





{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296392300000000}A bar, huh?
I wonder if Azuves
would be somewhere like this.


{C:81901701}{C:81958296B20100000000}You lot!
This is no place
for brats like you!

{C:81958296B30100000000}Leave at once.

{C:81900400}{C:819582963A2300000000}What?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582963B2300000000}Don't, Nelfea.

{C:819582963C2300000000}I understand.
Excuse us.

{C:81901701}{C:81958296B40100000000}As long as you understand.

{C:81900400}{C:819582963D2300000000}Why did you
back down so easily?

{C:8190D101}{C:819582963E2300000000}We're in enemy territory,
so it's wiser to keep a low profile
until we find Azuves.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296402300000000}That's true,
but it's so frustrating!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296412300000000}I'm frustrated too.
But for now, we have to put up with it.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296422300000000}All right, I get it!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296732300000000}Ughghghghghghgh...

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296742300000000}Huh?
Wataru, there's something weird about him.
He isn't recovering right away!

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296752300000000}That's what I told you!
People in this world
have different bodies from ours!

{C:81958296762300000000}He might be seriously hurt!

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296772300000000}Is thaaat so?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296782300000000}Big brother, are you all right?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582967A2300000000}Ow, ow, ow...
I'm all right for now.

{C:8190A502}{C:819582967B2300000000}I'm sorry, mister.
Come on, Himiko, you apologize too!

{C:8190A702}{C:819582967C2300000000}Nahahahaha!
Sorry, sorry!

{C:8190A502}{C:819582967D2300000000}I said apologize properly!

{C:8190A702}{C:819582967E2300000000}I apologize properly.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F2300000000}It's all right. I'm not hurt.
But please, no more
headbutts, okay?

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296802300000000}Got it!
You're a nice guy, mister.

{C:81958296812300000000}I'm Himiko!
I'm the head of the Shinobibe clan!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296822300000000}I see. Nice to meet you.

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296832300000000}Nice to meet you!
This is Wataru.

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296842300000000}I'm Wataru Ikusabe.

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296852300000000}It looks fun over there!
Fuhahahaha...


{C:8190A502}{C:81958296862300000000}The savior of Mt. Soukai... Hey,
Himiko!

{C:81958296872300000000}We're really sorry!
Bye!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296882300000000}Is it just me, or do they
seem completely out of place
in this world?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296892300000000}I agree...





{x00}

You're from another continent, aren't you?!
It's obvious from your clothes!!

{C:81958296F52300000000}I'll capture you and drag you
before His Majesty!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F62300000000}Not again!

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296F72300000000}Let's run!

{C:8190B901}{C:81958296F82300000000}Good grief. How uncivilized.
Are you all right, mademoiselle?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F92300000000}Oh, thank you.
You saved me.

{C:8190B901}{C:81958296FA2300000000}I am {C:819782830400}George de Sand.{C:819782830000}
Might I ask your name?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FB2300000000}I'm R-Rie Akatsuki.

{C:8190B901}{C:81958296FC2300000000}Rie... What a beautiful name.
Miss Rie, this is a dangerous place.
Please take care.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FD2300000000}Y-yes...

{C:8190B901}{C:81958296FE2300000000}Now, if you'll excuse me.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296FF2300000000}Heh.
He's rather unusual, isn't he?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296002400000000}He's so pretentious...
He's unbelievably pretentious.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296012400000000}Isn't that fine?
Rie seems happy enough.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296022400000000}I guess so...



{x00}
